positions.reasoning: Gold has broken below its 112-120 box (109.62 against my 117.14 average) as the metals complex is liquidated. Goldfinger names 106.50 as the next stop test. Goldfinger's reduce call is only conviction 5 and World still holds gold with a buy-stop at 120.80, so I will not sell into the break today. I park a stop exit at 106.50 so a second leg down is cut automatically, and a close back above 112 leaves the line intact.

QQQS.L (3x) against NVDA's 183 EUR of Nasdaq exposure is about 61 EUR. BX4.PA (2x) against AIR.PA's ~291 EUR of CAC exposure is about 145 EUR. 3EUS.MI is not on the approved inverse list. I am not rounding any hedge up to the band. NVDA (150.96 USD, -31% on cost) sits at yolo-sapiens-usd's breakdown level, but that call is bearish on the index and was not the thesis that opened the position. I will not crystallise the loss on one session's tape: December loss-harvesting is the right window to review it. BTC (59,034) is in Satoshi's markdown range with a 56.3k break level, and Satoshi says hold the core. ALV.DE and AIR.PA are within the European defensive book that World and Steady-Eddie hold. PHAG.L (40.74 USD) has not hit Goldfinger's silver capitulation level of 39, so it is held and goes on the December harvest review.
